end.summary:
Practised choosing exact versus approximate values.
Practised rounding large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore.
Ayaan identified that exact values stay unchanged and do not get rounded.
Rounding responses showed a mix-up between dropping digits and rounding; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact and approximate values with Ayaan, including rounding large numbers to lakh and crore. They explained that an exact value keeps the number unchanged, and used place-value language such as “lakh ke baad teen zero.” A rounding mix-up remained: they sometimes removed digits instead of checking the next digit, and it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise rounding a few numbers by looking at the digit immediately to the right of the target place.
